description:
Morning Stress Reset 🌿 Bansuri Therapy to Release Tension & Start the Day Calm | Episode 2 of Morning Reset

If you wake up with yesterday still sitting in your shoulders - jaw tight, a to-do list already running - give yourself this before the day starts asking things of you.

This gentle Indian flute music is designed to release morning tension: long, slow breaths of bamboo flute that let the body soften and the mind settle before the day begins.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of warm bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) over a steady tanpura drone, breath-led and unhurried, with no vocals.

🌿 MORNING RESET is our Bansuri Therapy series: calm-morning sessions at 6:30 IST. This is Episode 2.
Episode 1 — Morning Cortisol Reset → https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wINy9PW48iw

▶ Keep the calm going — the full Morning Energy playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199l9NGQ0ig-jCkqp0iwI3c7m
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for a slow morning, releasing stress before work, meditation, breathwork, yoga, tea or coffee by the window, journaling, prayer, a calm commute, or gentle stretching.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri (Indian bamboo flute) with tanpura drone
Raga: Ahir Bhairav (a soft, devotional dawn raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Loosening, steady, quietly clear
Atmosphere: Early light, a warm cup, the day not yet begun
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it as soon as you wake, before the phone. Drop your shoulders, breathe out a little longer than you breathe in, and let the long flute notes set the pace. Headphones bring out the breath in the bamboo; soft speakers work well too.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Before the day begins
9:00 Shoulders coming down
18:00 The long breath out
27:00 Tension leaving
36:00 A softer chest
45:00 Quiet and steady
54:00 Room to think
1:03:00 Calm settling in
1:12:00 Carried into the day
1:21:00 Ready, not rushed

⏱ BEST FOR
• Morning stress and tension
• A calm start before work
• Meditation and breathwork
• Yoga and gentle stretching
• Tea or coffee by the window
• Journaling and prayer
• A calm commute
• Lowering stress before a big day
• Reading
• Quiet background calm for the home

If this music helped you start calmer, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
